description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Returned Pastcaller.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
